in_marathi.name: Devishay
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devishay हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Devishay is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Deva' meaning god and 'Ishaya' meaning abode or home. This name symbolizes the divine dwelling place of the gods, and is often used as a reminder of the spiritual connection between the individual and the divine.
